title: Legi’s adventure v5 matched balance benchmark

execution_validation.v5_campaign_execution: Two complete seeds followed by three independent one-seed processes, merged in declared seed order. Only completed runs retained.

method.choices: Greedy damage/speed/range strategy chooses only from actual offered buttons; wholly ineffective upgrades are deprioritized. Relics selected from actual three offers.
method.controls: Equipment-aware eight-direction physical-key input at 12 Hz, ordinary collision movement, AStarGrid2D obstacle routing when line of sight is blocked, telegraph/bullet avoidance, and normal emergency dash. Dash build also dashes offensively. Identical controller/probe source is used for v4 and v5.
method.damage_definition: Sum of actual HP removed by accepted damage_player calls, after armor/invulnerability and capped at remaining HP on lethal hits; healing does not subtract from this counter.
method.limitations: Small seeded automated sample, not a human difficulty assessment. Perfect knowledge of visible telegraphs favors this controller; collision navigation is approximate and timeouts remain possible. Old/new offers differ because RNG implementation and eligible pools changed; independent encounter arena geometry is matched by arena_seed.
method.outcomes: Cleared, died, or still alive at the 120-second timeout. A timeout is not a death; clear-time medians exclude timeouts/deaths.
method.progression: Natural full run: real attacks, XP, drops and healing; no injected kills or health resets. Automatic center-portal entry only after combat and all rewards.

method.choices: Greedy damage/speed/range strategy chooses only from actual offered buttons; wholly ineffective upgrades are deprioritized. Relics selected from actual three offers.
method.controls: Ordinary collision movement; no dash. Horizontal reverses at arena edges/obstacles; pursue follows the closest enemy.
method.damage_definition: Sum of actual HP removed by accepted damage_player calls, after armor/invulnerability and capped at remaining HP on lethal hits; healing does not subtract from this counter.
method.limitations: Small seeded automated sample, not a human difficulty assessment. Perfect knowledge of visible telegraphs favors this controller; collision navigation is approximate and timeouts remain possible. Old/new offers differ because RNG implementation and eligible pools changed; independent encounter arena geometry is matched by arena_seed.
method.outcomes: Cleared, died, or still alive at the 120-second timeout. A timeout is not a death; clear-time medians exclude timeouts/deaths.
method.progression: Independent healthy-entry encounters: preceding stages supply their exact total dropped XP and legal random three-option rewards. HP is set to normal maximum at entry. No injected kills or HP changes in measured combat; this is not a prior-stage survival result.

interpretation_limits: Five selected deterministic seeds are a reproducible regression sample, not an estimate of human win probability.

Starting abilities assume prior discovery/unlock: Farshot for sword and ranger, Starlight for mage, Comet Tail for dagger/dash, and Life Drain for the drain policy. This is not a first-ever profile benchmark.

Campaigns carry real HP, upgrades, XP, drops and damage through all stages. Healthy-entry encounters reset normal maximum HP and synthesize exact prior XP plus legal guardian rewards; their survival rates are not campaign survival rates.
The controller sees every visible committed cue and predicts projectile motion. This is stronger than typical human play in some respects and weaker at tactical navigation in others.

Old/new primary attacks, enemy encounters and random eligible reward pools differ. Matched seeds are not identical combat circumstances, and this comparison does not isolate enemy tuning from player weapon changes.
Identical controller/probe source and reward scoring were used on both releases. A legacy radial magic unlock does not cause sword range to be treated as staff range.

Timeouts remain alive at 120 seconds; they are not deaths and are excluded, with deaths, from clear-time medians. Their positions, remaining enemies, line of sight and controller routes are preserved in raw rows.

Late campaign summaries are conditioned on reaching those stages. Paired late rows avoid comparing different seed/strategy/stage identities but do not remove all survivor/entry-state selection effects.
Damage is actual positive HP removed after armor and immunity, capped at remaining HP for lethal hits. Healing does not subtract; repeated damage can exceed entry max HP.
No gameplay balance was tuned in response to the final five-seed sample. No injected combat kills, HP inflation, damage immunity, enemy repositioning or forced guardian attacks.
